question: What is the full form of MB?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Megabyte**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of **MB** is **Megabyte**.
 
• A **Megabyte** is a unit of digital information storage, which is commonly used to measure the size of data.
 
• One **Megabyte** is equal to **1,024 Kilobytes** or approximately **1,000,000 bytes**.
 
• It is often used to specify the size of files, such as documents, images, and software applications.
 
• The term **Megabyte** is derived from the SI prefix **mega**, meaning one million.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The prefix **mega** is used in the International System of Units (SI) to denote a factor of one million (10⁶).
 
• In computing, the term **Megabyte** was originally used to describe 1,048,576 bytes (2²⁰), but it is now commonly used to refer to 1,000,000 bytes.
 
• The size of a **Megabyte** can vary depending on the context in which it is used, such as in computer memory or storage.
 
• Other common units of digital information storage include **Kilobyte (KB)**, **Gigabyte (GB)**, and **Terabyte (TB)**.
